title: viburnum dentatum var. indianense
intro: Viburnum dentatum var. indianense, commonly known as Indian arrowwood, is a deciduous shrub native to the United States, particularly in the Midwest and Northeast regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The health benefits of Indian arrowwood include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Indian arrowwood include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide protection against chronic diseases.
